meta.name: SFG Financial Services — Data Protection Business Architecture (DRUVA)
meta.description: Full business architecture for SFG's DRUVA data protection deployment covering VMware on-premises, Azure IaaS, and Microsoft 365 workloads.

cap_manage_backup_policy_framework.name: Manage Backup Policy Framework
cap_manage_backup_policy_framework.description: Ability to define, maintain and enforce backup policies across all workload types.

cap_manage_retention_standards.name: Manage Retention Standards
cap_manage_retention_standards.description: Ability to govern data retention rules meeting FCA and GDPR obligations.

cap_manage_sla_obligations.name: Manage SLA Obligations
cap_manage_sla_obligations.description: Ability to define and maintain backup SLA commitments including RTO and RPO targets.

cap_manage_regulatory_compliance.name: Manage Regulatory Compliance
cap_manage_regulatory_compliance.description: Ability to ensure backup activities conform to FCA, GDPR, and financial services requirements.

cap_manage_audit_trail.name: Manage Audit Trail
cap_manage_audit_trail.description: Ability to generate, retain and provide evidence of backup activity for audit purposes.

cap_manage_data_sovereignty_controls.name: Manage Data Sovereignty Controls
cap_manage_data_sovereignty_controls.description: Ability to enforce rules governing where backup data is stored and processed.

cap_govern_business_continuity_plans.name: Govern Business Continuity Plans
cap_govern_business_continuity_plans.description: Ability to maintain and validate business continuity plans relying on DRUVA.

cap_manage_disaster_recovery_readiness.name: Manage Disaster Recovery Readiness
cap_manage_disaster_recovery_readiness.description: Ability to schedule, execute and document DR tests across all workload environments.

cap_govern_rto_rpo_commitments.name: Govern RTO/RPO Commitments
cap_govern_rto_rpo_commitments.description: Ability to define, measure and report against RTO and RPO targets per workload.

cap_manage_vmware_vm_protection.name: Manage VMware VM Protection
cap_manage_vmware_vm_protection.description: Ability to protect VMware VMs using DRUVA agentless integration with application-consistent backups.

cap_manage_sql_database_backup.name: Manage SQL Database Backup
cap_manage_sql_database_backup.description: Ability to protect SQL Server databases with transaction-log aware granular backup.

cap_manage_datacentre_asset_inventory.name: Manage Datacentre Asset Inventory
cap_manage_datacentre_asset_inventory.description: Ability to discover, register and maintain a current inventory of on-premises assets requiring backup.

cap_manage_azure_vm_backup.name: Manage Azure VM Backup
cap_manage_azure_vm_backup.description: Ability to protect Azure IaaS VMs using DRUVA cloud-native backup capabilities.

cap_manage_cloud_snapshot_management.name: Manage Cloud Snapshot Management
cap_manage_cloud_snapshot_management.description: Ability to create, retain and manage Azure VM cloud snapshots with policy-driven lifecycle.

cap_manage_cross_region_data_replication.name: Manage Cross-Region Data Replication
cap_manage_cross_region_data_replication.description: Ability to replicate backup data across Azure regions for geographic redundancy.

cap_manage_m365_email_protection.name: Manage M365 Email Protection
cap_manage_m365_email_protection.description: Ability to protect Exchange Online mailboxes with granular item-level recovery.

cap_manage_m365_collaboration_data_backu.name: Manage M365 Collaboration Data Backup
cap_manage_m365_collaboration_data_backu.description: Ability to protect SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Teams data with full fidelity backup.

cap_manage_saas_application_coverage.name: Manage SaaS Application Coverage
cap_manage_saas_application_coverage.description: Ability to manage backup coverage scope across all M365 services without gaps.

cap_manage_backup_job_scheduling.name: Manage Backup Job Scheduling
cap_manage_backup_job_scheduling.description: Ability to schedule and automate backup jobs across VMware, Azure, and M365 from a single console.

cap_manage_incremental_and_full_backup_c.name: Manage Incremental & Full Backup Cycles
cap_manage_incremental_and_full_backup_c.description: Ability to manage full and incremental backup schedules optimised per workload type.

cap_manage_backup_storage_optimisation.name: Manage Backup Storage Optimisation
cap_manage_backup_storage_optimisation.description: Ability to apply deduplication and compression to minimise cloud storage consumption.

cap_manage_granular_file_recovery.name: Manage Granular File Recovery
cap_manage_granular_file_recovery.description: Ability to restore individual files, emails, or database records from any recovery point.

cap_manage_full_system_restore.name: Manage Full System Restore
cap_manage_full_system_restore.description: Ability to execute full VM, database, or M365 tenant restores from any recovery point.

cap_manage_point_in_time_recovery.name: Manage Point-in-Time Recovery
cap_manage_point_in_time_recovery.description: Ability to restore workloads to a specific point in time, critical for ransomware recovery.

cap_manage_backup_job_monitoring.name: Manage Backup Job Monitoring
cap_manage_backup_job_monitoring.description: Ability to monitor all backup and recovery job outcomes in real time from a unified dashboard.

cap_manage_alert_and_incident_notificati.name: Manage Alert & Incident Notification
cap_manage_alert_and_incident_notificati.description: Ability to generate and route alerts for backup failures, missed jobs, or capacity warnings.

cap_manage_backup_performance_reporting.name: Manage Backup Performance Reporting
cap_manage_backup_performance_reporting.description: Ability to produce operational performance reports showing backup success rates and storage trends.

cap_manage_ransomware_detection.name: Manage Ransomware Detection
cap_manage_ransomware_detection.description: Ability to detect ransomware through DRUVA anomaly detection by identifying unusual backup patterns.

cap_manage_immutable_backup_storage.name: Manage Immutable Backup Storage
cap_manage_immutable_backup_storage.description: Ability to store backup data in WORM-compliant immutable storage that cannot be deleted by ransomware.

cap_manage_anomaly_and_threat_alerting.name: Manage Anomaly & Threat Alerting
cap_manage_anomaly_and_threat_alerting.description: Ability to alert IT security teams when data anomalies or unusual access are detected.

cap_manage_air_gapped_backup_vault.name: Manage Air-Gapped Backup Vault
cap_manage_air_gapped_backup_vault.description: Ability to maintain logically air-gapped backup copies isolated from production networks.

cap_manage_data_isolation_policies.name: Manage Data Isolation Policies
cap_manage_data_isolation_policies.description: Ability to enforce policies isolating backup data from primary infrastructure networks.

cap_manage_encrypted_data_transmission.name: Manage Encrypted Data Transmission
cap_manage_encrypted_data_transmission.description: Ability to ensure all backup data is encrypted in transit and at rest using AES-256.

cap_manage_role_based_access_control.name: Manage Role-Based Access Control
cap_manage_role_based_access_control.description: Ability to assign granular RBAC permissions to DRUVA platform users by role.

cap_manage_multi_factor_authentication.name: Manage Multi-Factor Authentication
cap_manage_multi_factor_authentication.description: Ability to enforce MFA for all DRUVA console access preventing unauthorised access.

cap_manage_privileged_access_governance.name: Manage Privileged Access Governance
cap_manage_privileged_access_governance.description: Ability to govern and audit privileged access to DRUVA administrative functions.

cap_manage_backup_console_administration.name: Manage Backup Console Administration
cap_manage_backup_console_administration.description: Ability to administer the DRUVA unified management console managing configuration and users.

cap_manage_agent_deployment_and_updates.name: Manage Agent Deployment & Updates
cap_manage_agent_deployment_and_updates.description: Ability to deploy, update, and maintain DRUVA backup agents across VMware and Azure environments.

cap_manage_licence_and_capacity_planning.name: Manage Licence & Capacity Planning
cap_manage_licence_and_capacity_planning.description: Ability to manage DRUVA licence entitlements and forecast backup storage capacity requirements.

cap_manage_api_and_connector_integration.name: Manage API & Connector Integration
cap_manage_api_and_connector_integration.description: Ability to integrate DRUVA with SFG IT management tools and monitoring platforms via REST API.

cap_manage_cloud_storage_tier_management.name: Manage Cloud Storage Tier Management
cap_manage_cloud_storage_tier_management.description: Ability to manage backup data lifecycle across DRUVA cloud storage tiers for cost optimisation.

cap_manage_siem_and_security_tool_integr.name: Manage SIEM & Security Tool Integration
cap_manage_siem_and_security_tool_integr.description: Ability to stream DRUVA security events and audit logs into SFG SIEM for centralised monitoring.

cap_manage_sla_performance_reporting.name: Manage SLA Performance Reporting
cap_manage_sla_performance_reporting.description: Ability to produce executive reports demonstrating backup success rate and RTO/RPO achievement.

cap_manage_cost_optimisation.name: Manage Cost Optimisation
cap_manage_cost_optimisation.description: Ability to monitor and optimise total cost of DRUVA data protection versus previous fragmented approach.

cap_manage_vendor_support_engagement.name: Manage Vendor Support Engagement
cap_manage_vendor_support_engagement.description: Ability to engage DRUVA 24/7 support for incident resolution and product guidance.

obj_sfg.name: SFG
obj_sfg.definition: A Party that owns and controls all organisational data and holds regulatory obligations for data protection under FCA and GDPR.

obj_it_admin.name: IT Administrator
obj_it_admin.definition: A Party that manages the DRUVA backup platform on behalf of SFG holding responsibility for backup configuration, monitoring, and recovery execution.

obj_business_user.name: Business User
obj_business_user.definition: A Party employed by SFG whose M365 mailbox, Teams, and OneDrive data is protected by DRUVA.

obj_regulator.name: Regulator
obj_regulator.definition: A Party (FCA, ICO) that holds SFG accountable for data protection obligations and has authority to audit compliance evidence.

obj_protected_workload.name: Protected Workload
obj_protected_workload.definition: A Resource of value representing a VMware VM, Azure IaaS VM, or M365 service dataset that is the subject of DRUVA backup protection.

obj_recovery_point.name: Recovery Point
obj_recovery_point.definition: A Resource representing a recoverable backup copy of a Protected Workload stored in DRUVA's cloud vault at a specific point in time.

obj_licence_entitlement.name: Licence Entitlement
obj_licence_entitlement.definition: A Resource representing SFG's subscription rights to DRUVA services, defining the number and types of workloads that can be protected.

obj_storage_capacity.name: Storage Capacity
obj_storage_capacity.definition: A Resource representing the cloud backup storage allocated to SFG within DRUVA's platform for retaining Recovery Points.

obj_backup_policy.name: Backup Policy
obj_backup_policy.definition: A Record that documents the protection rules, schedules, and retention settings applied to each Protected Workload type.

obj_backup_job.name: Backup Job
obj_backup_job.definition: A Record that documents the execution of a backup event, including workload, timestamp, status, duration, and data transferred.

obj_recovery_request.name: Recovery Request
obj_recovery_request.definition: A Record that documents a request to restore data, including the workload, recovery point selected, requester, and outcome.

obj_threat_alert.name: Threat Alert
obj_threat_alert.definition: A Record that documents a detected ransomware anomaly, deletion spike, or security event identified by DRUVA's threat intelligence.

obj_compliance_obligation.name: Compliance Obligation
obj_compliance_obligation.definition: A Record that documents a regulatory requirement (FCA, GDPR) that SFG's backup and data protection practices must satisfy.

obj_audit_record.name: Audit Record
obj_audit_record.definition: A Record that documents backup activity, access events, and recovery actions as tamper-proof compliance evidence.

obj_sla_report.name: SLA Performance Report
obj_sla_report.definition: A Record that documents DRUVA platform availability, backup success rates, and RTO/RPO performance against SFG's SLA commitments.

obj_continuity_plan.name: Continuity Plan
obj_continuity_plan.definition: A Record that documents SFG's disaster recovery procedures, tested recovery scenarios, and approved RTO/RPO commitments per workload.

vs_data_recovery_assured.name: Data Recovery Assured
vs_data_recovery_assured.trigger: Workload (VMware VM, Azure VM, or M365 service) identified as requiring backup protection
vs_data_recovery_assured.outcome: Workload continuously protected, threats contained, data recoverable with full compliance evidence

stg_workload_onboarded.name: Workload Onboarded
stg_workload_onboarded.entryCriteria: Workload identified for backup protection and included in scope
stg_workload_onboarded.exitCriteria: Workload registered in DRUVA with backup connector or agent deployed, capacity allocated, access controls active

stg_protection_policy_applied.name: Protection Policy Applied
stg_protection_policy_applied.entryCriteria: Workload registered in DRUVA with connector active
stg_protection_policy_applied.exitCriteria: Backup policy live; first full backup completed; RTO/RPO targets defined; SLA obligations documented

stg_data_continuously_protected.name: Data Continuously Protected
stg_data_continuously_protected.entryCriteria: First backup complete; policy configured and active
stg_data_continuously_protected.exitCriteria: Automated incremental backup running on schedule; monitoring active; storage optimised; cross-region replication enabled

stg_security_threat_identified.name: Security Threat Identified
stg_security_threat_identified.entryCriteria: DRUVA anomaly detection flags ransomware activity, unusual deletion, or data exfiltration pattern
stg_security_threat_identified.exitCriteria: Threat contained; clean pre-attack recovery point identified and isolated in air-gapped vault

stg_data_recovery_executed.name: Data Recovery Executed
stg_data_recovery_executed.entryCriteria: Restore request raised — either post-incident recovery or planned DR test
stg_data_recovery_executed.exitCriteria: Data restored to operational state; production systems back online; RTO/RPO commitments met

stg_compliance_evidence_produced.name: Compliance Evidence Produced
stg_compliance_evidence_produced.entryCriteria: Recovery complete — or scheduled reporting/audit period reached
stg_compliance_evidence_produced.exitCriteria: Full audit trail available; compliance obligations evidenced; SLA report published; continuity plan updated

outcome_continuous_protection.name: Continuous Automated Protection
outcome_continuous_protection.description: All three SFG workload environments (VMware, Azure, M365) are backed up automatically on DRUVA-managed schedules with zero manual intervention.

outcome_ransomware_resilience.name: Ransomware Resilience
outcome_ransomware_resilience.description: SFG maintains clean, immutable, air-gapped recovery points that cannot be encrypted or deleted by ransomware, ensuring recovery from any attack.

outcome_regulatory_compliance.name: Regulatory Compliance Assured
outcome_regulatory_compliance.description: SFG can produce comprehensive audit trails and compliance evidence for FCA and ICO requirements from a single DRUVA platform.

outcome_cost_reduction.name: Infrastructure Cost Reduction
outcome_cost_reduction.description: SFG eliminates expensive, fragmented on-premises backup infrastructure, replacing it with DRUVA's cloud-based SaaS model.

role_it_admin.name: IT Administrator
role_it_admin.description: Manages DRUVA platform configuration, backup monitoring, recovery execution, and vendor engagement on behalf of SFG.

role_security_team.name: Security Team
role_security_team.description: Monitors DRUVA threat alerts, manages SIEM integration, and governs incident response for ransomware events.

role_compliance_officer.name: Compliance Officer
role_compliance_officer.description: Reviews audit records, manages regulatory obligations, and validates compliance evidence for FCA/ICO reporting.

metric_rto.name: Recovery Time Objective (RTO)
metric_rto.description: Maximum acceptable time to restore a workload after data loss. DRUVA target: <4 hours for VMware VMs, <2 hours for Azure VMs, <1 hour for M365.

metric_rpo.name: Recovery Point Objective (RPO)
metric_rpo.description: Maximum acceptable data loss period. DRUVA target: <1 hour for VMware and Azure, <24 hours for M365.

metric_backup_success_rate.name: Backup Success Rate
metric_backup_success_rate.description: Percentage of scheduled backup jobs completing successfully. DRUVA SLA target: >99.5%.

metric_cost_per_tb.name: Cost per TB Protected
metric_cost_per_tb.description: Total monthly DRUVA cost divided by total protected data volume, used to demonstrate cost improvement versus legacy approach.

info_druva_dashboard.name: DRUVA Unified Dashboard
info_druva_dashboard.description: Single-pane-of-glass view of all backup jobs, alerts, recovery points, and platform health across all three SFG workload environments.

info_audit_log.name: DRUVA Audit Log
info_audit_log.description: Tamper-proof log of all platform activity including backup events, user access, policy changes, and recovery actions exported to SIEM.

info_compliance_report.name: Compliance Evidence Pack
info_compliance_report.description: Packaged collection of audit logs, backup success reports, and recovery test results suitable for FCA/ICO regulatory submission.
